title.narrative: Roma Education Fund 2 Förbättrad utbildn för romer
Roma Education Fund 2 Improving Roma Education

description.narrative: Roma Education Fund arbetar med romers rätt till utbildning, med att minska klyftan mellan romer och icke-romer vad gäller utbildning och med att motverka segrigeringen av romer inom utbildningssystemet. Projektet "Förbättrad utbildning för romer" omfattar följande länder; Albanien, Bosnien och Hercegovina, Kosovo, Makedonien, Moldavien, Montenegro, Serbien, Turkiet och Ukraina. Beslutsnr: 2011-004126.

Roma Education Fund works for the human rights of the Romas to Education, to closing the gap in educational outcomes between Roma and non-Roma and against segregation of Romas in the educational systems. The project Improving Roma Education covers Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, Macedonia, Moldova, Montenegro, Serbia, Turkey and Ukraine. Decision no: 2011-004126.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Within the 17 projects supported with Sida funding, REF partners have worked in 148 municipalities and five countries, with 9,259 Romani children. Out of these, 3,024 beneficiaries were in preschool programs, 4,053 in primary education, 1,810 in secondary scholarships program and 372 in tertiary education. In the 2014-2015 academic year, REF granted scholarship, with support from Sida, to three students in Bosnia and Herzegovina and 62 students in Macedonia. REF's advocacy efforts have resulted in national and local governments' taking increased resposibility for decreasing the education gap between the roma and non-Roma population.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
